definitionZh: 位置区 CSS 属性使锚定点元素相对于其相关锚定点元素的边缘定位,将位置元素放置在隐含的3x3格的一块或数块上,其中锚定点元素为中心单元格.
sourceDefinition: The position-area CSS property enables an anchor-positioned element to be positioned relative to the edges of its associated anchor element by placing the positioned element on one or more tiles of an implicit 3x3 grid, where the anchoring element is the center cell.
